## sqrt() -> double
```{r}
res <- sqrt(9.1)
print(paste(res, typeof(res)))
```

## round() double (double-typed integer)
```{r}
res <- round(3.1415926, digits = 3)
print(paste(res, typeof(res)))
```

## Generate an ordered sequence: 
```{r}
print(seq(from=1, to=10, by=2))
```

## Repeats a value: 
```{r}
lst = rep(x=5, times=7)
print(paste(lst, typeof(lst)))
```

```{r}
x <- 4e-3
print(x)
```


```{r}
ch = "I am happy :)"
num = 142857
log = TRUE

print(paste(ch, num, log))
print(paste(class(ch), class(num), class(log)))
```


```{r}
cell_ID_CX1 = "CX1"
cell_ID_CX2 = "CX2"
treated_CX1 = TRUE
treated_CX2 = FALSE
num_cells_before_CX1 = 5415
num_cells_before_CX2 = 8123
num_cells_after_CX1 = 1432
num_cells_after_CX2 = 7543

print("cell_ID treated num_cells_before num_cell_after")
print(paste(cell_ID_CX1, treated_CX1, num_cells_before_CX1, num_cells_after_CX1))
print(paste(cell_ID_CX2, treated_CX2, num_cells_before_CX2, num_cells_after_CX2))
```

```{r}
print(TRUE + TRUE) # TRUE == 1
print(TRUE + FALSE) # FALSE == 0
print(5 + TRUE)
```


```{r}
x <- NA
print(x == NA)
print(is.na(x))

x <- 0 / 0
print(x)
print(is.na(x))
print(is.nan(x))

y1 <- 1 / 0
print(y1)
print(paste(typeof(y1), class(y1)))


y2 <- -1 / 0
print(y2)
print(paste(typeof(y2), class(y2)))
```



```{r}
group <- factor(c("Control", "Treatment", "Control"))

typeof(group)
class(group)

unclass(group)
```


```{r}
df <- data.frame(
  age = c(18, 19, 20),
  name = c("Alice", "Bob", "Charlie")
)

typeof(df)
class(df)

print(df)
summary(df)
```
